description: Animated Treemap is not only used for tracking hierarchical data but also offers an interactive, time-based exploration of data patterns. The animation feature allows users to witness the evolution of data, showing trends and how each categories importance changes in a given context. This makes it an ideal tool for exploring complex datasets with multiple levels of detail in an engaging and informative manner. Key Feature Hierarchical Data Representation : Treemaps display data in a hierarchical structure, with each level represented by a colored rectangle. The size of each rectangle is proportional to a specific measure, such as sales or revenue. Legend : The built-in legend supports multiple positions, customizable text size, and color options to fit your dashboard theme and improve data comprehension. Data lable : Our visual offers flexible data labeling options, allowing you to toggle visibility, adjust font size and color, and fine-tune numeric formatting (e.g., units and precision). Perfect for delivering precise insights at a glance. Business Use Cases Sales Analysis : Animated Treemaps are ideal for analyzing sales data by different categories, such as product types or regions.
